assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh, embedded PBR maps, skeleton and animation; no third-party inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Slightly stooped, narrow-shouldered ordinary person in an oversized white shirt with a shaped torso, thin cuffs, separate shirttail panels, loose slate trousers and black cloth shoes.
artDirection.bodyDetail: Layered shirt collar and placket, curved torso rings, folded shirttail panels, draped sleeves with narrow sewn cuffs, articulated fingers and thumbs, trouser creases, cuffs, shaped shoes and layered soles.
artDirection.face: Ash-silver hair, half-lidded tired eyes, under-eye shadows and a small flat mouth.
artDirection.props: A hanging blank role placard marked only with a dash, dark cords, one red mending stitch and a mismatched sock cuff.
artDirection.motion: Weary breathing, shuffling walk with sleeve and shirttail follow-through, hesitant shrug, placard display, nervous flinch, grounded fall and a weak victory wave.
artDirection.gameplay: No passive or exclusive skill is implied. All eight clips are generic visual poses only.

rig.type: glTF SkinnedMesh skeleton with baked TRS animation tracks
rig.binding: Continuous three-bone limb skinning; rigid parts use one normalized joint weight. PlacardPivot follows Chest.

clips.name: walk
clips.semantic: shuffling in-place walk with sleeve and shirttail follow-through

clips.semantic: hesitant shrug and explanation with sleeve and shirttail response

clips.name: cast
clips.semantic: looks down and presents blank placard

clips.name: dead

integration.runtimeRegistration: Not performed; production CharacterRig integration remains a separate task.

limitations: Polished procedural stylization, not a photorealistic scan or externally generated character.
No gameplay passive, skill, damage rule or elimination logic is included.
Runtime registration and CharacterRig integration are intentionally excluded.
